site: Example bench (PAL3 robot arm; example-only values, not device facts)
notes: Example only: the clone states no rail or tool travel, so these ranges stand for the workspace of one installed PAL3. Replace them with the envelope of the deployed rail, trays and workcell.

position.x.reason: example only: replace with the X travel of the deployed PAL3 rail

position.y.reason: example only: replace with the Y travel of the deployed PAL3 tool

position.z.reason: example only: replace with the Z travel of the deployed PAL3 tool

dx.reason: example only: replace with the allowed relative X travel of the deployed PAL3

dy.reason: example only: replace with the allowed relative Y travel of the deployed PAL3

dz.reason: example only: replace with the allowed relative Z travel of the deployed PAL3
